connector.name: Warrant
connector.registryDescription: Record an agent's decisions with reasons anyone can re-execute offline - verify recomputes them.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package warrant-verify. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the s0fractal account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: WARRANT_STORE
env.description: Absolute path to the warrant store this server files into and verifies. Defaults to .warrants relative to the server process's working directory, which an MCP host does not guarantee.

env.name: WARRANT_KEY
env.description: Ed25519 signing key. If unset, one is generated next to the store on the first filing and the result says so; any process that can read it can sign as this actor.

env.name: WARRANT_ACTOR
env.description: Actor id written into filed warrants. Defaults to mcp-client@<hostname>.
